title: The secret to desire in a long-term relationship
speaker: Esther Perel

sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast So, why does good sex so often fade,
sentences.zh: 为何性爱的激情那么容易褪色？

sentences.en: even for couples who continue to love each other as much as ever?
sentences.zh: 就算是那些爱得如胶似漆的夫妇也无一例外。

sentences.en: And why does good intimacy not guarantee good sex, contrary to popular belief?
sentences.zh: 为何亲密的爱情也无法维持激情的色彩呢？这和我们普遍对性生活与爱情的关系的认知相违背。

sentences.en: Or, the next question would be, can we want what we already have?
sentences.zh: 或者说，换第二个问题:我们能留住我们现有的性生活频率吗？

sentences.en: That's the million-dollar question, right?
sentences.zh: 这可是个很值得研究的问题，对吧?

sentences.en: And why is the forbidden so erotic? What is it about transgression that makes desire so potent?
sentences.zh: 再者，为什么偷腥会令人如此激情彭拜?又是什么东西令人在偷尝云雨之情时有如此旺盛的性欲呢？

sentences.en: And why does sex make babies, and babies spell erotic disaster in couples?
sentences.zh: 又是为何性爱孕育了儿女而儿女却最终反过来却成为夫妻性爱的灾难呢？

sentences.en: (Laughter) It's kind of the fatal erotic blow, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这对于性欲可是种致命的打击，不是么？

sentences.en: And when you love, how does it feel? And when you desire, how is it different?
sentences.zh: 还有，当你爱时，你有什么感受?并且当你产生欲望时，这种感受又会有什么不同的变化?

sentences.en: These are some of the questions that are at the center of my exploration on the nature of erotic desire and its concomitant dilemmas in modern love.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我今天想要探讨的问题-----探索现代爱情中人类的原始性冲动和其伴随而来的困境

sentences.en: So I travel the globe, and what I'm noticing is that everywhere where romanticism has entered, there seems to be a crisis of desire.
sentences.zh: 为了这一研究，我去了很多国家而我注意到凡是浪漫的国度都面临着性欲消退的危机。

sentences.en: A crisis of desire, as in owning the wanting -- desire as an expression of our individuality, of our free choice, of our preferences, of our identity -- desire that has become a central concept
sentences.zh: 欲望消退危机----正如我们的需要一样,性欲作为我们对自身个体的表达：是对于我们的自由选择、偏好和身份的一种需要性欲已经成为

sentences.en: as part of modern love and individualistic societies.
sentences.zh: 现代爱情和崇尚个人主义的社会的核心概念

sentences.en: You know, this is the first time in the history of humankind where we are trying to experience sexuality in the long term not because we want 14 children,
sentences.zh: 要知道，这是人类历史上首次我们长期体验性爱不是为了生一大堆孩子,比如说14个。

sentences.en: for which we need to have even more because many of them won't make it, and not because it is exclusively a woman's marital duty.
sentences.zh: -----或许我们部分人可能要生养育更多，以防很多可能会夭折，也不是源于女人生儿育女的天职。

sentences.en: This is the first time that we want sex over time about pleasure and connection that is rooted in desire.
sentences.zh: 人类第一次将我需要性的观点超越了仅仅是体内的性欲在作怪是因为性爱能给人们带来愉悦和稳定的关系。

sentences.en: So what sustains desire, and why is it so difficult?
sentences.zh: 那么,究竟是什么在维持着人的性欲?而维持性欲为何又这么难呢？

sentences.en: And at the heart of sustaining desire in a committed relationship, I think, is the reconciliation of two fundamental human needs.
sentences.zh: 要维持夫妻关系中的性欲的关键我认为在于协调两种人类的基本需求。

sentences.en: On the one hand, our need for security, for predictability, for safety, for dependability, for reliability, for permanence.
sentences.zh: 一方面，是我们对安全、可预测性、安全感、可靠性、可依赖感和对永恒的需要。

sentences.en: All these anchoring, grounding experiences of our lives that we call home.
sentences.zh: 所有这些生活中能为我们提供所需的厚实而安稳的体验的地方就是我们所说的"家"。

sentences.en: But we also have an equally strong need -- men and women -- for adventure, for novelty, for mystery, for risk, for danger, for the unknown, for the unexpected, surprise --
sentences.zh: 但同时, 无论男女, 我们,还有另一种强烈的需要---那就是对冒险，对新奇事物，神秘、危险、风险以及对未知有的、预料之外和惊喜的渴望。

sentences.en: you get the gist. For journey, for travel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是我们喜欢出游，旅行

sentences.en: So reconciling our need for security and our need for adventure into one relationship, or what we today like to call a passionate marriage, used to be a contradiction in terms.
sentences.zh: 这就意味着在一段关系中，要协调我们对安稳感的需求和对猎奇的需要，我们今天称之为 “有激情的婚姻”过去曾是相互矛盾的的两个方面

sentences.en: Marriage was an economic institution in which you were given a partnership for life in terms of children and social status and succession and companionship.
sentences.zh: 婚姻曾经是一种经济制度你可以从中获得某种合作关系,它一般以孩子，社会地位继承权以及同伴的形式出现。

sentences.en: But now we want our partner to still give us all these things, but in addition I want you to be my best friend and my trusted confidant and my passionate lover to boot, and we live twice as long.
sentences.zh: 可如今，我们在希望我们的伴侣可以继续提供这些的同时又要求他们成为我们的知己做我们可交心的伴侣和激情四射的情人甚至还想长生不老呢（笑声）

sentences.en: (Laughter) So we come to one person, and we basically are asking them to give us what once an entire village used to provide.
sentences.zh: 所以,当我碰到我们的另一半时，我们简直在向对方要求给我们这些过去原本一整个村庄才能提供的东西：

sentences.en: Give me belonging, give me identity, give me continuity, but give me transcendence and mystery and awe all in one.
sentences.zh: 如财产，名份，至死不渝的忠贞爱情,同时你还得让我觉得你是卓尔不群，有神秘感和有敬畏心。

sentences.en: Give me comfort, give me edge. Give me novelty, give me familiarity.
sentences.zh: 安抚我的同时带给我刺激。给我新鲜感的同时又要保持亲密。

sentences.en: Give me predictability, give me surprise.
sentences.zh: 让我过安稳的日子的同时还要能给我惊喜。

sentences.en: And we think it's a given, and toys and lingerie are going to save us with that.
sentences.zh: 多数人认为这是奉献，性玩具和性感睡衣就能解决这些问题。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) So now we get to the existential reality of the story, right?
sentences.zh: （掌声）现在我们应该说清楚性爱激情的现实部分了,对吧?

sentences.en: Because I think, in some way -- and I'll come back to that -- but the crisis of desire is often a crisis of the imagination.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，从某种角度讲-- 一会我们再会回到这个话题其实欲望危机就是想象力的危机。

sentences.en: So why does good sex so often fade? What is the relationship between love and desire?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么美妙的性爱体验容易消散呢？爱和欲之间的联系到底是什么呢？

sentences.en: How do they relate, and how do they conflict?
sentences.zh: 它们是怎样联系起来的，又是怎么相互冲突的呢？

sentences.en: Because therein lies the mystery of eroticism.
sentences.zh: 横亘在这两者之间的是性欲的奥秘。

sentences.en: So if there is a verb, for me, that comes with love, it's "to have."
sentences.zh: 如果要我用一个动词来描述爱，那就是“拥有"

sentences.en: And if there is a verb that comes with desire, it is "to want."
sentences.zh: 而对于性欲,我想用"索求"来描述最恰当不过了。

sentences.en: In love, we want to have, we want to know the beloved.
sentences.zh: 在爱情中，我们想要拥有，我们想要了解我们的爱人

sentences.en: We want to minimize the distance. We want to contract that gap.
sentences.zh: 我们想腻在一起，想跨越阻碍

sentences.en: We want to neutralize the tensions. We want closeness.
sentences.zh: 我们想调和不安的情绪，我们想亲密无间。

sentences.en: But in desire, we tend to not really want to go back to the places we've already gone.
sentences.zh: 而在性欲方面，我们不想回到我们已经经历过的地方。

sentences.en: Forgone conclusion does not keep our interest.
sentences.zh: 过时的结论提不起我们的兴趣。

sentences.en: In desire, we want an Other, somebody on the other side that we can go visit, that we can go spend some time with, that we can go see what goes on in their red-light district.
sentences.zh: 在性欲方面，我们想找的是我们的另一半，一个在彼岸,一个我们想去探索的另一半。一个我们想呆在一起的另一半和一个我们能探索其瘾秘的内心世界的另一半

sentences.en: You know? In desire, we want a bridge to cross.
sentences.zh: 在性欲中，我们想找的是一座沟通的桥梁。

sentences.en: Or in other words, I sometimes say, fire needs air.
sentences.zh: 换言之，“一个巴掌拍不响啊”

sentences.en: Desire needs space. And when it's said like that, it's often quite abstract.
sentences.zh: 性欲也需要空间。这样说或许有点抽象吧。

sentences.en: But then I took a question with me. And I've gone to more than 20 countries in the last few years with "Mating in Captivity," and I asked people, when do you find yourself most drawn to your partner?
sentences.zh: 带着一个问题几年间我带着"Mating in Captivity" 这本书走访了20多个国家每到一处，我都会问人们:"你什么时候最喜欢和爱人呆在一起？"

sentences.en: Not attracted sexually, per Se, but most drawn.
sentences.zh: 我说的是呆在一起而不是一起性爱

sentences.en: And across culture, across religion, and across gender -- except for one -- there are a few answers that just keep coming back.
sentences.zh: 来自不同文化、不同地区、不同性别的人除一个有点例外，其它人给我的回答不外如是

sentences.en: So the first group is: I am most drawn to my partner when she is away, when we are apart, when we reunite.
sentences.zh: 第一组：最想和爱人在一起的时候是爱人不在身边的时候、是分开的时候或是小别重逢时。

sentences.en: Basically, when I get back in touch with my ability to imagine myself with my partner, when my imagination comes back in the picture, and when I can root it in absence and in longing,
sentences.zh: 也就是，当我能用我的想象力想像我和爱人在一起的时候，当我的想像力能回到这方面来的时候，当爱人不在而我又想要的时候

sentences.en: which is a major component of desire. But then the second group is even more interesting.
sentences.zh: 这就是性欲的主要组成部分然而，另一组回答更有趣。

sentences.en: I am most drawn to my partner when I see him in the studio, when she is onstage, when he is in his element, when she's doing something she's passionate about, when I see him at a party and other people are really drawn to him,
sentences.zh: 我最想和爱人在一起的时候是当我看到他在录影棚工作、在舞台上表演的时候、当他在做正经事的时候、当他在做她感兴趣的事情的时候，当我看到他在party上谜倒一大堆人的时候

sentences.en: when I see her hold court. Basically, when I look at my partner radiant and confident.
sentences.zh: 当她开庭的时候。一般而言，当我看到我的爱人光芒四射而又自信的时候

sentences.en: Probably the biggest turn-on across the board.
sentences.zh: 这就是最大的刺激物了。

sentences.en: Radiant, as in self-sustaining. I look at this person -- by the way, in desire people rarely talk about it, when we are blended into one, five centimeters from each other.
sentences.zh: 光芒四射，在自我维系中也如此。在欲望中， 我看这个人人们很少谈论这些, 当我们粘在一起的时候

sentences.en: I don't know in inches how much that is.
sentences.zh: 也就是相隔5厘米左右的时候---说实在的我不知道是几厘米

sentences.en: But it's also not when the other person is that far apart that you no longer see them.
sentences.zh: 但是,这种分别并不是说相隔太远以至于以后都不能相见。

sentences.en: It's when I'm looking at my partner from a comfortable distance, where this person that is already so familiar, so known, is momentarily once again somewhat mysterious, somewhat elusive.
sentences.zh: 而是我能在一个比较合适的距离看着我爱的人那个我熟悉和相知的，还带有点神秘,有点难以捉摸的人。

sentences.en: And in this space between me and the other lies the erotic élan, lies that movement toward the other.
sentences.zh: 我和爱人之间的距离成了一条性欲的纽带也造成了我们的相互走动

sentences.en: Because sometimes, as Proust says, mystery is not about traveling to new places, but it's about looking with new eyes.
sentences.zh: 因为有时候，正如Proust说的那样发现奥秘不一定要到一个新的地方去，而只要我们有新视角就行。

sentences.en: And so, when I see my partner on his own or her own, doing something in which they are enveloped, I look at this person and I momentarily get a shift in perception, and I stay open to the mysteries that are living right next to me.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们看到我们的另一半独自在忙自己的事的时候。看着他我会对他有一种新的了解和认识，而我对我身过的一些奥秘是常怀着关注之情的。

sentences.en: And then, more importantly, in this description about the other or myself -- it's the same -- what is most interesting is that there is no neediness in desire.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，对别人的了解或者对自己的了解, 都一样.最有趣的是，这不需要性欲。

sentences.en: Nobody needs anybody. There is no caretaking in desire.
sentences.zh: 没有谁需要谁。性欲不存在谁照顾谁的问题。

sentences.en: Caretaking is mightily loving. It's a powerful anti-aphrodisiac.
sentences.zh: 照顾是一种了不起的大爱，是一种强大的崔情药

sentences.en: (Laughter) I have yet to see somebody who is so turned on by somebody who needs them.
sentences.zh: 我还看到一些人的性欲是被那些需要他们的人唤起的

sentences.en: Wanting them is one thing. Needing them is a shot down and women have known that forever, because anything that will bring up parenthood will usually decrease the erotic charge.
sentences.zh: 想要是一回事，但需要会令人性趣索然这点女人最清楚了，因为任何母性有关的东西都会降低性欲。

sentences.en: (Laughter) For good reasons, right? And then the third group of answers usually would be: when I'm surprised, when we laugh together, as somebody said to me in the office today,
sentences.zh: 很有道理，是不是?第三类回答是:当我感到惊喜时，当我们一起大笑时会性趣大发，比如说，今天有人在我的办公室告诉我，

sentences.en: when he's in his tux, so I said, you know, it's either the tux or the cowboy boots.
sentences.zh: 当他穿着无尾半正式晚礼服时最有感觉了其实性欲与晚礼服或牛仔靴无关

sentences.en: But basically it's when there is novelty.
sentences.zh: 而是与猎奇有关。

sentences.en: But novelty isn't about new positions. It isn't a repertoire of techniques.
sentences.zh: 但新奇并不只意味着新的体位，也不是五花八门的性爱技巧

sentences.en: Novelty is, what parts of you do you bring out?
sentences.zh: 新奇是,你将自已的哪一面展现出来？

sentences.en: What parts of you are just being seen? Because in some way one could say sex isn't something you do, eh?
sentences.zh: 你的哪一面你的爱人熟悉？因为在某种程度上，我们会说性交并不专指性交活动，对吧?

sentences.en: Sex is a place you go. It's a space you enter inside yourself and with another, or others.
sentences.zh: 性交过程其实像你在去一个地方是一个进入自己或对方体内的过程。

sentences.en: So where do you go in sex? What parts of you do you connect to?
sentences.zh: 因此，性交时何去何从？你们身体的哪一部分有接触?

sentences.en: What do you seek to express there? Is it a place for transcendence and spiritual union?
sentences.zh: 你们想在那里表达些什么？那是一个表现性爱技巧和精神合一的地方吗？

sentences.en: Is it a place for naughtiness and is it a place to be safely aggressive?
sentences.zh: 那是一个俏皮掏蛋的地方呢还是一个略带点侵略性质的地方呢？

sentences.en: Is it a place where you can finally surrender and not have to take responsibility for everything?
sentences.zh: 还是一个你最后放弃不想负责任的地方呢?

sentences.en: Is it a place where you can express your infantile wishes?
sentences.zh: 它是不是一个你可以表达你孩子气的地方呢？

sentences.en: What comes out there? It's a language. It isn't just a behavior.
sentences.zh: 性爱到底是什么？ 其实性交是一种语言。不是一种行为。

sentences.en: And it's the poetic of that language that I'm interested in, which is why I began to explore this concept of erotic intelligence.
sentences.zh: 而我，正是对这一充满诗意的性交语言感兴趣这就是为什么我要探讨"性商"这一概念。

sentences.en: You know, animals have sex. It's the pivot, it's biology, it's the natural instinct.
sentences.zh: 要知道，动物也性交。而动物的性交是传宗接代的，是生物的，是一种自然的天性。

sentences.en: We are the only ones who have an erotic life, which means that it's sexuality transformed by the human imagination.
sentences.zh: 人类是唯一过性生活的物种，所谓性生活完全是人类想象出来的东西

sentences.en: We are the only ones who can make love for hours, have a blissful time, multiple orgasms, and touch nobody, just because we can imagine it.
sentences.zh: 人类也是唯一能持续几个小时做爱有幸福时光，有多次高潮而没有身体抚摸的动物，因为人类能想象出这些东西。

sentences.en: We can hint at it. We don't even have to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以用意念来交欢，根本就不用直接的身体接触。

sentences.en: We can experience that powerful thing called anticipation, which is a mortar to desire.
sentences.zh: 我们能体验强大的性期待那可是性欲的动机，

sentences.en: The ability to imagine it, as if it's happening, to experience it as if it's happening, while nothing is happening and everything is happening, at the same time.
sentences.zh: 能想得到的，它就可以是发生的能体验到好像正在发生的，而实际上却没发生任何事所有这些都可以同时发生

sentences.en: So when I began to think about eroticism, I began to think about the poetics of sex.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我想到性兴奋时，我就会想到性爱的美妙。

sentences.en: And if I look at it as an intelligence, then it's something that you cultivate.
sentences.zh: 而如果我把它看作一种“智商”那么，它就应该是你应该培养的东西。

sentences.en: What are the ingredients? Imagination, playfulness, novelty, curiosity, mystery.
sentences.zh: 性商包括什么呢？想象力、情趣、新鲜感、好奇心和神秘感。

sentences.en: But the central agent is really that piece called the imagination.
sentences.zh: 但其核心是想象力。

sentences.en: But more importantly, for me to begin to understand who are the couples who have an erotic spark, what sustains desire, I had to go back to the original definition of eroticism, the mystical definition,
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，如果说我要弄清楚哪些夫妇有性火花，什么东西方维系着性爱, 我必须得回顾一下性爱的最原始的定义,这一最神秘的定义，我经历过的

sentences.en: and I went through it through a bifurcation by looking, actually, at trauma, which is the other side.
sentences.zh: 以一种分岐，通过创伤来看这就是另一面，让我来看看

sentences.en: And I looked at it, looking at the community that I had grown up in, which was a community in Belgium, all Holocaust survivors, and in my community, there were two groups: those who didn't die, and those who came back to life.
sentences.zh: 看看我成长的社区那是一个在比利时的社区，所有人都是大屠杀的幸存者在这个社区里，有两类人：一类是没有死过的，另一类是死后重生的

sentences.en: And those who didn't die lived often very tethered to the ground, could not experience pleasure, could not trust, because when you're vigilant, worried, anxious, and insecure, you can't lift your head to go and take off in space

sentences.en: and be playful and safe and imaginative.
sentences.zh: 在性爱中解放自我，没有情趣，没安全感也缺乏想象力。

sentences.en: Those who came back to life were those who understood the erotic as an antidote to death.
sentences.zh: 那些劫后余生的人他们把性事当作忘却死亡的解药。

sentences.en: They knew how to keep themselves alive. And when I began to listen to the sexlessness of the couples that I work with, I sometimes would hear people say, "I want more sex," but generally, people want better sex,
sentences.zh: 他们知道怎样让自己活下去。当我听到我的那些无性生活的同事的故事时有时我听到别人说：我想要更多的性生活。但很多时候，人们更在意性生活的质量,

sentences.en: and better is to reconnect with that quality of aliveness, of vibrancy, of renewal, of vitality, of Eros, of energy that sex used to afford them, or that they've hoped it would afford them.
sentences.zh: 最好的是能过传统意义上性生活能提供给他们的活力、新鲜感、动感、和充满动力的性爱或者他们希望能得到这性爱。

sentences.en: And so I began to ask a different question.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会问另一个问题：

sentences.en: "I shut myself off when ..." began to be the question.
sentences.zh: 我何时不会有性欲。
